ابتدعوا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَدَعُوا (ibtadaʕū) /ib.ta.da.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# اُبْتُدِعُوا (ubtudiʕū) /ub.tu.di.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# اِبْتَدِعُوا (ibtadiʕū) /ib.ta.di.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
